system.description: A sliver of cloudy glass that shows an object as it could become. Warm it between thumb and forefinger while altering an existing form.
system.bindsAndStrands: Bind: Change. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Bind Thread per casting.

system.description: A needle made from the first shed scale of a river wyrm. Its owner threads it through a seam before changing that thing’s shape.
system.bindsAndStrands: Bind: Change. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Bind Thread per casting.

system.description: White chalk whose circle remains faintly visible after it is wiped away. Break its tip while calling matter into being.
system.bindsAndStrands: Bind: Conjure. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Bind Thread per casting.

system.description: A palm-sized bell that makes no audible sound until a new thing answers it. Ring once at the start of a Conjure binding.
system.bindsAndStrands: Bind: Conjure. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Bind Thread per casting.

system.description: A marsh reed tied into a knot that tightens when a commanded thing obeys. Keep one hand on it while casting.
system.bindsAndStrands: Bind: Control. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Bind Thread per casting.

system.description: A short length of rope taken from a ship’s abandoned helm. Each knot untied lends force to a command.
system.bindsAndStrands: Bind: Control. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Bind Thread per casting.

system.description: An obsidian tooth with an edge warm enough to blister wax. Press it against the target’s image or shadow when ending something.
system.bindsAndStrands: Bind: Destroy. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Bind Thread per casting.

system.description: Ash sealed in a black paper twist, swept from a gate destroyed in a siege. Scatter a pinch to hasten an ending.
system.bindsAndStrands: Bind: Destroy. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Bind Thread per casting.

system.description: A small lens polished from stone found inside a thunderhead. Condensation forms on it when unseen facts are revealed.
system.bindsAndStrands: Bind: Witness. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Bind Thread per casting.

system.description: A wax tablet scored with questions its maker never dared speak. Rub away one line to seek an answer.
system.bindsAndStrands: Bind: Witness. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Bind Thread per casting.

system.description: A stoppered jar holding the last breath of a storm messenger. Crack the seal and listen for sounds beyond the ordinary.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Air. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A pale blue wire drawn from a lightning-struck bell. It hums when touched by cold, sound or heatless light.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Air. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A tooth shed by a stag no hunter could catch. Hold it to call on the patterns of creatures native to this world.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Beasts. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: Iridescent dust gathered from the wings of moths that circle only moonless fires. Scatter sparingly over a beast’s trace.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Beasts. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A brass ring cut with a narrow groove for a drop of blood. The metal warms when magic touches flesh or healing.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Body. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A smooth bone thimble passed between generations of village midwives. A tap against the skin steadies a Body spell.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Body. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A needle that points toward the nearest unbroken bedrock instead of north. Grip its case while working stone or metal.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Earth. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A seed of dark iron said to have fallen from a tree of ore. Each filed shaving carries a little of its weight.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Earth. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A coal preserved from the first fire lit in a winter refuge. It glows without consuming itself until its magic is spent.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Fire. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: Red salt crystallised where an old fire refused to die. Cast a few grains into a flame or lamp before shaping it.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Fire. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A little knot of living root that curls around the wearer’s finger. It stirs when a plant grows or strains.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Plants. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A husk from a seed that flowered under snow. Crush a fragment to coax life and structure from plants.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Plants. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A cut crystal that splits starlight into impossible colours. Peer through it to orient magic toward distant planes.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Spheres. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A silver map pin recovered from a chart of a place that does not exist. Twist its head when seeking a path beyond this world.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Spheres. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A candle stub from a wake that lasted seven nights. Its flame bends toward unseen spirits rather than the wind.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Spirit. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A strip of linen tied around a hand when a solemn vow was kept at great cost. Unwind it to brace the soul.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Spirit. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A tarnished pocket mirror that returns an expression a moment too late. Its reflection helps shape dreams and impressions.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Thought. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A tiny vial of ink made from a forgotten scholar’s unfinished manuscript. Write one word to steady a thought or illusion.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Thought. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A vial of seawater that rises and falls though its cork is sealed. Turn it over to work liquid, ice or falling rain.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Water. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.

system.description: A dull pearl recovered where nine rivers meet. Its surface thins as its wearer draws on the Water Strand.
system.bindsAndStrands: Strand: Water. Use only while physically touching the Thread; one Strand Thread per casting.
